as a result of

引出造成某个结果的原因：由于。

as a result of + 名词／动名词；as a result of higher costs；as a result of reducing waste。还需要主句表达结果。

World food output per head has risen by 4 per cent between the 1970s and 1980s mainly as a result of increases in yields from land already in cultivation, but also because more land has been brought under the plough.

原文涉及历史农业数据，只用来观察句法；其中年代和比例不当作当前事实。

原文：

Governments, farming and environmental management

日常语境例句

The school saved money as a result of reducing food waste.

学校通过减少食物浪费节省了开支。

of 是介词，后面不能直接放一个普通完整句。because 后接完整句；because of / as a result of 后接名词或 doing。明确因果依据，不把同时发生当作因果。
